resources.string: • Ledger Tasks now ask for a faction, not a specific rat, and look the part
Back up your progress, or restore it from a file.
Your rats, Scrap, level, EXP and anything in progress, in one JSON file.
Importing replaces everything you have now — every rat, your Scrap, level and EXP. This cannot be undone.\n\nExport your current save first if you want to keep it.
Your level. It climbs as you walk, and higher levels turn up rarer rats.
Every step you have ever walked. It only ever climbs, and it is what the Achievements are measured against.
Scrap, your currency. Earn it by walking and spend it in the Shop.
Whether a rat is out on a Scrap Run, and how long is left of it.
Today\'s walking, and roughly how far it comes to. This one resets every morning.
Your daily streak. Tap the lantern for today\'s quest — it burns brighter the longer you keep it going.
Your deepest Battle Arena run, and the badges earned along the way. Tap to see them on the Achievements screen.
The Battle Arena: an escalating 15-fight gauntlet for your strongest rat, no healing between fights, with an exclusive reward for clearing it.
Pick the one rat this run is built around — no swapping once the run starts.
A recovering rat is greyed out and can\'t be picked here until it\'s back on its feet.
Confirm locks them in and starts the climb.
Pick two rats to feed the Fusion Pot — the mutant it mints takes the higher Power and Toughness of the two, plus one.
Each parent\'s faction can roll its own bonus effect on the splice — what fired shows right on the result card.
Confirm spends the Scrap and reveals what you got.
Short, Medium, or Long — pick a walking contract and it starts tracking your steps right away. Only one runs at a time.
A Ledger Task needs a rat clearing its stat requirement, not just its faction. Send one off and it\'s back when the timer runs out.
A Ledger Task has a chance to pay out a Relic on top of its usual reward. Your running total sits here.
Rat King Recon runs on your feet. Every step you take out in the world earns EXP toward your next rat, and Scrap to spend on gear.
Your phone counts your steps in the background, even with the app shut. Fill the EXP bar and the egg splits open — a new rat is yours.
Every rat you hatch is written into the Ledger. Sort by Power, filter for shinies, and fill the collection out — there are %1$d species to find.
Feed two weak rats to the Fusion Pot to mint a stronger mutant. Out walking, Rustbots will block your path — fight one yourself, or settle it straight from the notification.
That is everything. Get walking, and your first rat will not be far off.
The ongoing step-counter notification is required by Android and cannot be turned off.

Start over from Level 1 with an empty Ledger.

Raises your rat\'s Power and maximum HP by half for a single fight, then it is spent — win or lose. Only one combat buff rides a fight, so it cannot be combined with a Power Surge. The extra HP is what carries a rat through the last boss.
One combat buff per fight — spend the one you are holding first.
Restores %1$d%% of max HP instantly, then %2$d%% more at the start of every round for the rest of the fight.
Corrodes the enemy for %1$d%% of your rat\'s Power a round, for %2$d rounds. Stacks with itself, and while any charge is active, Attack also piles on a lighter %3$d%% stack of its own.
